$comment: Copy of pdf-extraction/benchmarks/schemas/ghgi.schema.json from branch mr/pdf-taxonomy-extraction at commit dc595f6b9. Describes result.data of a precomputed extraction envelope.

reporting_year.description: Requested inventory year, not publication year.

reported_total_tco2e.description: Explicitly reported city/community-wide total for the requested year, in tonnes CO2e. Prefer gross emissions unless case_context specifies another boundary. Null when no total is printed; never invent a sum.

total_basis.description: Explain the total boundary (gross/net/core, city/region/community/corporate), source unit, and important alternative totals.

rows.description: Distinct detailed CO2e emissions/notation rows for the requested year. Avoid duplicate facts and overlapping aggregates/subtotals. Keep removals; exclude separately reported biogenic CO2.

source_label.description: Original source row label, including enough context to identify it.

gpc_ref.description: Use a subsector prefix such as I.1 with scope null when the source does not split scopes. GPC reference supported by source meaning; null when unclear. scope.description: GPC scope, if supported by source/definitions.

emissions_tco2e.description: Source emissions normalized to tonnes CO2e. Preserve original value/unit and explain conversion in evidence notes. Null for notation-only rows.

notation_key.description: Original notation such as NO, NE, IE or C. Null for numeric rows.

row_role.description: Meaning of this row in the source. Retain removals with negative emissions_tco2e. Exclude separately reported biogenic CO2 and other information from the selected total.

total_inclusion.description: Whether this distinct row belongs in the selected reported_total_tco2e boundary. Exclude removals for gross, include for net. Use source protocol/boundary rules, not a row-sum fit. Explain unclear decisions; never silently drop an unmapped numeric row.

scope_basis.description: Explicit scope column or source-supported inference from energy/source meaning. Combined scopes keep scope null and a parent GPC reference. Unknown scope stays null; do not guess to match a benchmark.

reported_gross_total_tco2e.description: Explicitly printed gross emissions total; null if unavailable. Excludes removals.

reported_removals_tco2e.description: Explicitly reported removal total as a negative number. Preserve original sign convention in evidence. Null if unavailable; do not infer from gross/net.

reported_net_total_tco2e.description: Explicitly printed net total including removals. Null if unavailable; do not calculate an unreported total.

total_kind.description: Basis of reported_total_tco2e; choose from source definitions and case guidance, never an expected answer.

reconciliation_tolerance_tco2e.description: Maximum arithmetic discrepancy explained by source rounding for the distinct included rows and selected printed total, in tonnes. Derive from printed precision (half a last printed digit for each rounded value) and explain the derivation in evidence. Never choose it from the observed gap or an expected answer. Null if precision cannot be established.
